resources.string: Replaces Edge\'s download popup with a Copy / Download dialog; downloads are handed over to the system downloader or a third-party downloader app.
Replaces Edge\'s download confirmation with a Copy / Download dialog; the download is created by the selected downloader, not by Edge.
Note: the last hook installation failed, please check the log
Note: interception is currently disabled, Edge uses its native downloader.
No injection report from Edge yet. Please check:
1. the module is enabled in LSPosed;
2. the scope includes Edge (this module declares it statically, but some managers still need it checked manually);
3. Edge was force-stopped and reopened (switching to background is not enough), then wait about 10 seconds;
4. if it still does not appear, search the LSPosed log for \'EdgeSysDL\' and \'module loaded\'.
Scope: com.microsoft.emmx\n(declared statically by the module; if it stays inactive, confirm the scope in LSPosed)
When off, Edge keeps its native download behaviour and no dialog is shown
Interception enabled (no need to restart Edge)

After tapping Download: the system downloader uses Android\'s DownloadManager; third-party downloaders must be installed. If a downloader cannot be started, the system downloader is used as a fallback.
Package not detected; the setting is kept anyway
The log records every interception, skip (with reason) and download hand-off result.

Entries are written when the following happens in Edge:
· module injected / hook installation result
· every interception and skip (with reason) and every download hand-off
